questions: Does the CLI --json flag output machine-parseable JSON with comment IDs?

answers.answer: Yes. list.ts parses --json flag and outputs JSON.stringify(comments) which includes id, author, content, isHelixTagged, isAgentAuthored, createdAt fields. Default human-readable output is unchanged.

statement: Added --json output flag to hlx comments list command. TypeScript clean, build successful, all 63 tests pass.
